description: Source code for a header ABI linker tool that processes dump files, handles symbol exporting, and generates linked output, primarily used in Android's development environment.

classes.name: HeaderAbiLinker
classes.description: Class responsible for linking ABI dump files, handling symbol exports, and generating a combined output.

methods.name: LinkAndDump
methods.description: Performs the linking of input dump files, exports symbols, links types/functions/variables, and outputs the final linked dump.

methods.name: ReadInputDumpFiles
methods.description: Reads and merges multiple dump files in parallel using multithreading.

methods.name: ReadExportedSymbols
methods.description: Reads exported symbols from a shared object file or version script.

methods.name: ReadExportedSymbolsFromVersionScript
methods.description: Parses the version script to extract exported symbols.

methods.name: ReadExportedSymbolsFromSharedObjectFile
methods.description: Parses a shared object (.so) file to extract exported symbols.

methods.name: LinkTypes
methods.description: Links various type definitions from the module.

methods.name: LinkFunctions
methods.description: Links function symbols from the module.

methods.name: LinkGlobalVars
methods.description: Links global variable symbols from the module.

methods.name: LinkExportedSymbols
methods.description: Links exported symbols into the linked module.

methods.name: IsSymbolExported
methods.description: Checks if a symbol is considered exported based on the parsed symbol sets.
